videos.title: The Lost, Canceled, and Cut Content of Spore | Lost Media
videos.what_it_shows: Contains a segment (starting around 21:21 / t=1281) discussing the lost 2009 Flash game Spore 2D Creature Creator (spore2d.com) and showcasing surviving gameplay footage of the 2D side-view creature editor and training minigame.
videos.real_title: The Lost, Canceled, and Cut Content of Spore | Lost Media

videos.title: 50 Cases Of Wii Lost Media
videos.what_it_shows: Features a segment at 18:19 ('Spore 2D') showing surviving gameplay clips of the 2009 Spore 2D promotional Flash game created to advertise Spore Hero.

notes: Direct standalone gameplay uploads of Spore 2D from 2009–2010 and developer portfolio uploads—such as 'spore 2d' and 'spore 2d sternomactuceus' by @spore198 (2009), 'Spore 2d' by @Namu165 (2010), 'Spore 2D' by developer Ben Smith / @benjoesmith (2023), and https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zloOfKdUY8Y—are Either unavailable/deleted on YouTube or lack unmasked public watch URLs in search indices. Another recent compilation featuring footage is '6 Obscure Lost Flash Games' by @statiqXP (segment at 1:52).
